item.title: Mamata Banerjee’s Delhi arrival fuels buzz over INDIA bloc meet with President
item.description: TMC chairperson Mamata Banerjee's arrival in Delhi has heightened anticipation for the requested meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. The opposition bloc is awaiting confirmation for a meeting date between October 7 and 9. The delegation has been limited to ten members as requested by the President's Secretariat. CPI(M)'s John Brittas has submitted a petition for constitutional intervention regarding the Election Commission.
item.dc:creator: Ambika Pandit

item.title: Centre cites Supreme Court order, seeks to void Jharkhand DGP appointment
item.description: Supreme Court has agreed to hear the application from the Centre regarding Tadasha Mishra's appointment as Jharkhand DGP. The appointment has been challenged due to its conflict with procedures set in the SC's 2006 Prakash Singh judgement. Moreover, the Centre claimed that prior DGP appointments in Jharkhand were also illegal for similar reasons. Mishra's appointment occurred shortly before her retirement, which raised legal concerns.
item.dc:creator: Dhananjay Mahapatra

item.title: 'Cash-for transfers' WhatsApp chats part of CBI dossier on Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann OSD
item.description: A set of WhatsApp chats has emerged, alleging monetary transactions involving senior Punjab government officials and DSPs. CBI's dossier includes these chats as they prepare to interrogate CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD Rajbir Singh Ghuman. Allegations suggest that intermediaries received bribes for influencing transfers and policy formulations affecting IAS and IPS officers. Additionally, documents indicate potential irregularities in real estate projects and the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority.
item.dc:creator: Raj Shekhar Jha and Vibhor Mohan

item.title: Medical trips costliest in both rural & urban areas
item.description: Health and medical trips incurred the highest expenses in rural and urban areas during a one-year period. The average expenditure for these trips was notably higher in urban than rural areas. Pilgrimage travel accounted for the largest share of trips taken throughout the year. Accommodation and transport were significant expenditures for health and medical trips, underscoring their financial impact.
item.dc:creator: Rema Nagarajan

item.title: With PM Modi set to visit Ottawa, India & Canada back CEPA
item.description: India and Canada are currently engaged in the fifth round of talks for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Both countries aim to sign the CEPA during Prime Minister Modi's anticipated visit to Canada. The visit is tentatively scheduled for December 11-13, just before the G20 summit in Florida. Leaders from both nations envision boosting bilateral trade to CAD 70 billion by 2030.
item.dc:creator: Sachin Parashar

item.title: Assam CM Himanta Sarma says woman sent to Bangladesh safe, son counters CM
item.description: Mumtaz Begum, a woman expelled to Bangladesh, remains untraceable by her family despite official claims of her safety. Her son, Momruz Ali, is pleading for government assistance to locate her in either country. The Gauhati High Court directed authorities to find Mumtaz and provide interim compensation to her husband. Reports indicate that searches in Bangladesh yielded no results for her whereabouts so far.
item.dc:creator: Ismat Ara

item.title: 'One student, one day': CUET-UG 2027 may get shorter, simpler
item.description: CUET-UG 2027 may implement notable changes to streamline the examination experience for students. Candidates could see a reduction in the number of subjects from five to four over time. The proposed changes also include shortening the duration of individual papers to enhance efficiency. Subject grouping may allow related papers to be scheduled together for a single-day examination.
item.dc:creator: Manash Pratim Gohain

item.title: Anti-CEC protests: Opposition, police face off again; Rahul Gandhi says won’t stop till Gyanesh quits
item.description: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc attempted to stage a protest demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. They were detained by Delhi Police less than a kilometer from their protest site at Jantar Mantar. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge organized the lunch gathering, where the protest plan was discussed. Difficulties in moving their buses led to further confrontations with police as they sought to demonstrate.

item.title: 'We'll do it': PM Modi gives slogan for 2047 goals; credits people’s support for 25-year unbroken run
item.description: PM Narendra Modi delivered a speech highlighting his 25 years in government and the goal of developed India by 2047. He called upon citizens to commit to this ambitious target and emphasized the power of the people. Modi reiterated the importance of extraordinary goals, linking good governance to societal inclusion. He reflected on his journey from humble beginnings to leadership in the BJP.
item.dc:creator: Kumar Rakesh

item.title: Grenade seizure case: Pakistan-based ultra declared ‘proclaimed offender’
item.description: A special NIA court in Jammu has declared Nazir Hussain a proclaimed offender regarding grenade seizures. Hussain, originally from Hari village, is believed to be hiding in Pakistan currently. The court noted that previous non-bailable arrest warrants could not be executed due to his absence from home. Additionally, multiple attempts to compel Hussain to surrender have been unsuccessful.
item.dc:creator: Sanjay Khajuria

item.title: India’s first high-altitude snow leopard safari flagged off in Ladakh
item.description: Ladakh has commenced India's first high-altitude wildlife safari that highlights snow leopard trails and community involvement. Vinai Kumar Saxena, the lieutenant governor, emphasized the importance of coexisting wildlife and development. The Snow Leopard and High-Altitude Nature Conservation Society is coordinating this project with local forest departments. The mapped safari routes traverse significant wildlife areas, including Hemis National Park and Changthang.
item.dc:creator: Sanjay Khajuria

item.title: NIA court rejects bail plea of separatist Shabir Shah in 1996 funeral violence case
item.description: A Jammu NIA court rejected the bail application of Shabir Ahmad Shah, linked to a 30-year-old mob violence case. This case relates to violence during a terrorist's funeral procession in Srinagar, which Shah allegedly incited. The court expressed concern about potential threats to national security and the safety of protected witnesses. Shah argued that the investigation was reopened without justification and emphasized delays in legal actions.
item.dc:creator: Naseer Ganai

item.title: Oceans connect, not divide nations, PM Modi says, calls for secure maritime order
item.description: PM Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of maritime connectivity and proposed a ceasefire plan for the Black Sea. His vision promotes cooperation and mutual benefit among nations to ensure maritime security. Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan highlighted the interconnectedness of national security and economic security. He urged for collective action among regions to tackle maritime threats effectively.
item.dc:creator: Dipak K Dash

item.title: Oligarchs blocking Starlink service in India: Elon Musk
item.description: During the India Mobile Congress event, Elon Musk criticized certain telecom operators in India, accusing them of obstructing Starlink services to maintain their market dominance. Musk pointed out the alarming fact that over 11,000 villages lack proper mobile coverage. SpaceX showcased its commitment to Indian operations by investing in necessary infrastructure while ensuring compliance with local regulations.

item.title: A quick lunch, then a Jantar Mantar march: How Rahul-led opposition once again kept police guessing
item.description: The episode was the latest example of a 'dhappa' style protest that Rahul Gandhi and the Congress have recently used. The latest episode began after Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge announced an INDIA bloc sit-in at Jantar Mantar following the lunch. "Today, we will hold a sit-in protest at Jantar Mantar. Until our demands are met, we will continue to stage such protests," Kharge announced.
